type.meaning: a business rule of an entity, a value object, a validator or a pure function - no I/O
a use case: one operation end to end, its collaborators replaced at their ports
an inbound adapter: how what arrives over that transport becomes a call
an outbound adapter to a store or a cache, against the real engine or its emulator
an outbound adapter that publishes to a broker, real or emulated
a client of another service, against that service or its emulator
an outbound adapter that reads and writes files
the translation between two representations of the same data, no I/O
the shape other code depends on: commands, events, a published schema
a technical check of the plumbing, not of a business capability: logging, configuration, packaging

category.meaning: an edge of what is allowed: empty, zero, the largest, the first, the last
invalid input is rejected with its error
a dependency or the environment fails, and the program says so
several actors at the same time
a defect found once, kept fixed
